notes.title: It's Pat Cat Time!
notes.content: [p]The game is officially available![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you to everyone who added the game to their wishlist! This is my first commercial game, and releasing it is a small personal accomplishment.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]It’s a small and modest game, but I really hope you’ll have fun decorating and dressing up your cat![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]To be honest, I’ve already been working for a while on my next game. But for now, it’s time to celebrate the release of [b]Pat Pat Cat[/b]! ₍^. .^₎⟆[/p]
